judgments.reason: The support_span 'QTc of 403 milliseconds' actually documents a normal QTc interval (normal range up to ~440-450 ms), which contradicts rather than supports a diagnosis of Long QT Syndrome (acquired or otherwise). There is no span in the vignette that clinically supports acquired Long QT Syndrome; the Holter showed polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with ST-segment elevation and R-wave fusion patterns more consistent with Brugada syndrome or ischemia-related arrhythmia, not prolonged QT.
